qualifier: cardiomyocyte adaptive growth and sarcomere organization
name: Cardiac contraction and cardiomyocyte adaptive growth regulation
rationale: All members regulate heart contractile force, rate, relaxation or cardiomyocyte growth/adaptation; the cardiac adaptation, cell growth and sarcomere members separate it from confusables centred on calcium handling, negative inotropy/chronotropy, or proliferation and regeneration.

qualifier: Golgi-to-endosome transport and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi–endosome membrane trafficking and tubulation
rationale: Members cover vesicle budding, Golgi positioning, Golgi-to-endosome and endosome-to-endosome transport, receptor recycling and membrane tubulation, while confusables add ARF/Rab GTPase regulation, Golgi organization or recycling control instead of Golgi-to-endosome traffic.

core: Polymerase-dependent DNA repair and replicative synthesis
qualifier: nucleotide excision repair and translesion synthesis
name: Nucleotide excision repair, translesion and replicative DNA synthesis
rationale: Members share PCNA/polymerase-driven DNA synthesis across UV-damage nucleotide excision repair, translesion synthesis, replication and telomere C-strand fill-in (plus error-prone somatic hypermutation), distinguishing it from mismatch-repair and base-excision-repair confusables.

qualifier: vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
name: Angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle cell phenotype control
rationale: Members span VEGF/Tie2-driven endothelial sprouting, proliferation and lymphangiogenesis together with vascular smooth muscle migration, proliferation and phenotypic switching, the latter separating it from the otherwise similar endothelial-only confusable and the leukocyte-adhesion confusables.

qualifier: B cell receptor diversification plus APOBEC antiviral editing
name: B cell receptor diversification and APOBEC cytidine deamination
rationale: Members combine antibody gene diversification (V(D)J, somatic hypermutation, early B cell commitment) with AID/APOBEC-type cytidine deamination and viral restriction, distinguishing it from virus-only confusables and from the class-switching/T cell confusable.

qualifier: fate specification, proliferation and myelinating differentiation
name: Glial fate specification, proliferation and myelination
rationale: All members concern glial fate, proliferation, survival, differentiation (oligodendrocyte, Schwann, astrocyte) and myelination, while confusables shift toward reactive gliosis, astrocyte activation or axonal signalling.

core: Cofactor metabolism and reactive aldehyde detoxification
qualifier: vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor with methylglyoxal handling
name: Vitamin cofactor metabolism and reactive aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members split between B6/molybdenum prosthetic-group metabolism (including Moco-dependent sulfide oxidation) and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification with glycation repair of protein and DNA, which together set it apart from glutathione, ROS and sulfur amino acid confusables; the link between the two halves is loose.

qualifier: oncogene/stress induction and heterochromatin foci
name: Oncogene- and stress-induced senescence and heterochromatin foci
rationale: Members concern induction and regulation of senescence (oncogene, oxidative stress, proliferation arrest, p53 dampening) with senescence-associated and subtelomeric heterochromatin, whereas confusables carry the secretory phenotype and Polycomb modules instead.

qualifier: inositol polyphosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
name: PTEN–AKT signalling and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation, AKT activation and its restraint together with phosphoinositide and inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis, the latter separating it from mTOR/TSC confusables and the PTEN/AKT members separating it from PAK-2 confusables.

qualifier: myelination, axon calibre and axonal growth signalling
name: Axon–glia interaction in myelination and axonal growth control
rationale: Members link myelin formation and maintenance, glial responses and axon calibre with neurotrophin-receptor-mediated axonal growth inhibition/stimulation, distinguishing it from regeneration/sprouting confusables and from the glial differentiation confusable.

qualifier: glucose-stimulated beta-cell function
name: Pancreatic endocrine development and glucose-stimulated beta-cell function
rationale: Members describe pancreatic progenitor and endocrine (alpha, beta, neuroendocrine) lineage development, and the beta-cell signature plus glucose-stimulated insulin secretion separate it from pancreatic-development and incretin confusables.

qualifier: regulation of turnover and protein stability
name: Regulation of proteasomal protein turnover and stability
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal degradation (degron pathways, K48 and auto-ubiquitination, ubiquitin-independent degradation, deubiquitinase processing) and protein stability or folding, unlike confusables centred on ribosome quality control, aggrephagy or ERAD.

qualifier: host translation subversion
name: RNA virus genome replication and host translation subversion
rationale: Members cover genome replication, transcription, RNP handling and translation strategies of influenza, RSV and coronaviruses, including hijack of host translation, contrasting with retrovirus/DNA virus, protein-maturation/entry and host translational-silencing confusables.

qualifier: COPI retrograde transport
name: ER–Golgi vesicle targeting and COPI retrograde transport
rationale: Members concern vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi and COPI budding and retrograde traffic, distinguishing it from COPII anterograde, ER protein insertion and vesicle tethering confusables.

qualifier: ephrin, DCC and L1 receptors
name: Ephrin, DCC and L1 axon guidance signalling
rationale: Members share axon guidance and fasciculation via ephrin, DCC and L1 signalling with RAC1 activation, the L1 members separating it from SLIT-ROBO and netrin confusables and the ephrin/DCC members from the CHL1/pruning confusable.

qualifier: canonical and non-canonical activation with negative regulation
name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB signalling and its restraint
rationale: All members regulate IKK/NIK-driven NF-kappaB activity downstream of TNFR1, CD40 and other receptors, including its negative regulation by deubiquitination and SUMO control, which TLR/TRAF6/TAK1 and lymphocyte confusables lack.

qualifier: CSF1 signalling
name: CSF1-driven microglia and macrophage proliferation and activation
rationale: Members share CSF1 receptor signalling and microglial/macrophage differentiation, proliferation, migration and activation, distinguishing it from interleukin, apoptotic-cell clearance and monocyte/dendritic differentiation confusables.

qualifier: Rhesus glycoproteins
name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: Members centre on Rh-family glycoproteins mediating ammonium and CO2 transport, their biosynthesis and deficiency, unlike erythrocyte oxygen-exchange and peptide-transporter confusables.

qualifier: trans-synaptic adhesion and glutamate/GABA receptor clustering
name: Synaptic adhesion and glutamate/GABA receptor clustering
rationale: Members concern pre- and postsynaptic assembly by neurexin-neuroligin and other adhesion molecules with clustering of AMPA, NMDA and GABA receptors and excitatory/inhibitory transmission, which confusables lack.

qualifier: neural plate, border and dorsoventral axis
name: Neural plate and dorsoventral axis patterning
rationale: Members share early embryonic patterning of the neural plate, its border and neural crest fate together with dorsoventral axis specification and boundary formation, separating it from limb and hindbrain/forebrain regionalization confusables.

qualifier: PUMA/NOXA BH3-only route to cytochrome c release
name: p53-induced PUMA/NOXA mitochondrial apoptosis
rationale: Members describe p53-driven intrinsic apoptosis through PUMA/NOXA BH3-only activation and cytochrome c release, unlike death-receptor, BAD/BIM/BMF or BAX/BAK pore-formation confusables.

qualifier: non-histone methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
name: Non-histone protein methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: Members cover lysine and arginine methylation (including p53) and lysine/proline hydroxylation, distinguishing it from histone-methylation and translation-factor modification (hypusine, diphthamide) confusables.

qualifier: bacterial entry and toxin uptake
name: Host–pathogen interaction via bacterial entry and toxin uptake
rationale: Members all describe pathogen interactions with host cells (bacterial attachment and invasion, anthrax/diphtheria toxin uptake, host responses to SARS and Leishmania), with bacterial entry and toxin uptake separating it from Mtb, protozoan and antimicrobial-killing confusables; cohesion is loose.

qualifier: DNA glycosylase recognition and its disease defects
name: DNA glycosylase lesion recognition and base excision
rationale: Members concern DNA glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases, APEX1 handoff and NTHL1/NEIL defects, whereas confusables carry AP-site processing, gap filling or alkylation reversal.

qualifier: terminal red cell maturation
name: Erythroid differentiation and red cell maturation
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment, differentiation and terminal red cell membrane maturation (one module is stress TAK1-ATF signalling), distinguishing it from megakaryocyte and stem/progenitor hematopoiesis confusables.
